chapter: Al Hibbler, Dakota Staton and later years
title: Hibbler years of shows, Ed Sullivan, Canada and the 1957 British tour
summary: For five years they play all over America and tour London, Liverpool and Glasgow for five or six weeks in 1957.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: He had these three big records that were making it. He had a lot of money coming in. And other things... Just everything was going his way, and everything went his way for the next, oh, five years, in which we played all over the United States and we did all kinds of shows. The Ed Sullivan Show two or three times, as I can remember. We played a lot
of places that had been foreign to me before -- a lot of places even in Canada where I had never worked before.

Meanwhile, a trip was brewing for him to go to Europe. So in 1957, he had another trip to Europe. This time it was on a plane, and we went over and we did a theatre tour over there. It wasn't really Europe, but it was England... We worked in England -- London, Liverpool, and Glasgow, Scotland, I think were the engagements. I think altogether it lasted five or six weeks.
